item.title: Poetry the Heart of things
item.description: Yesterday a small group of us met in the church library. The intent of the group is to meet on a regular basis and to read poetry together after the model of lectio divina. This is a practice that is very old and aims to listen to a text, closely and over several repetitions, paying attention to a circle of voices ranging from the words in front of us, the godly voice of the universe, and the voice of our conscience sending us into action or metanoia.
